Here is the complete structured summary of the MasterMove landing page codebase.

---

## 1. PROJECT STRUCTURE AND FRAMEWORK

**Framework:** Next.js 16.2.5 (App Router) with React 19.2.4, TypeScript 5.x

**Key config files:**
- `/home/jajang/mastermove-landing/package.json` -- dependencies and scripts
- `/home/jajang/mastermove-landing/next.config.ts` -- empty/default Next.js config
- `/home/jajang/mastermove-landing/tailwind.config.ts` -- Tailwind v4 with custom colors and fonts
- `/home/jajang/mastermove-landing/postcss.config.mjs` -- uses `@tailwindcss/postcss`
- `/home/jajang/mastermove-landing/tsconfig.json` -- path alias `@/*` maps to project root
- `/home/jajang/mastermove-landing/eslint.config.mjs` -- ESLint with Next.js core-web-vitals + TypeScript

**Dependencies:**
| Package | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `next` 16.2.5 | Framework |
| `react` / `react-dom` 19.2.4 | UI library |
| `framer-motion` ^12.38.0 | Animations (used heavily) |
| `lucide-react` ^1.14.0 | Icon library |
| `tailwindcss` ^4 | Styling |

**Folder structure:**
```
mastermove-landing/
  app/                  -- Next.js App Router pages + layout
    globals.css         -- Global styles and Tailwind component classes
    layout.tsx          -- Root layout (fonts, metadata)
    page.tsx            -- Main landing page (assembles all sections)
    favicon.ico
    projects/
      page.tsx          -- Project gallery page
      [slug]/page.tsx   -- Individual project detail page
  components/           -- Reusable UI components
    Navbar.tsx
    Footer.tsx
    ClientLogoSlider.tsx
    DynamicPageTitle.tsx
    project-detail/     -- Components for the /projects/[slug] page
      ProjectHero.tsx

      ResultsGrid.tsx
      TestimonialCard.tsx
      RelatedProjects.tsx
    shared/             -- Generic reusable building blocks
      DarkCard.tsx
      IconBadge.tsx
      ResultMetricCard.tsx
      SectionHeader.tsx
  sections/             -- Landing page section components
    HeroSection.tsx
    ServicesSection.tsx
    AboutSection.tsx
    WhyChooseUsSection.tsx
    CTASection.tsx
  src/components/       -- Additional components (separated)
    HeroSlider.tsx      -- Image carousel for the hero
  lib/
    animations.ts       -- Shared Framer Motion animation presets
  types/
    project.ts          -- TypeScript interfaces for Project data
  public/               -- Static assets (images, logos, SVGs)
```

---

## 2. LANDING PAGE SECTIONS (in render order)

The main page is at `/home/jajang/mastermove-landing/app/page.tsx`. It is a `"use client"` component that renders sections in this order:

### (a) DynamicPageTitle
- **File:** `/home/jajang/mastermove-landing/components/DynamicPageTitle.tsx`
- **Purpose:** Invisible component that dynamically updates `document.title` based on which section is currently in view as user scrolls. Maps section IDs to Indonesian/English titles like "Layanan - MasterMove", "Tentang Kami - MasterMove", etc.

### (b) Navbar
- **File:** `/home/jajang/mastermove-landing/components/Navbar.tsx`
- **Purpose:** Fixed top navigation bar. Features:
  - Logo on the left (`/mastermove-logo-navbar.svg`)
  - Desktop nav links: Home, Layanan (dropdown with "Layanan" and "Proyek" sub-items), Tentang Kami, Kontak
  - Orange CTA button "Hubungi Kami" (links to `#contact`)
  - Mobile hamburger menu (toggled open/close with X icon)
  - Scroll-aware: becomes opaque with border/shadow after scrolling 10px
  - Uses `backdrop-blur-xl` for glassmorphism effect

### (c) HeroSection
- **File:** `/home/jajang/mastermove-landing/sections/HeroSection.tsx`
- **Purpose:** Full-width hero with background image slider and text overlay. Contains:
  - **HeroSlider** (`/home/jajang/mastermove-landing/src/components/HeroSlider.tsx`): Auto-rotating image carousel (4 slides, 4-second interval) with 4 hero images (`/hero/hero-1.webp` through `hero-4.webp`). Crossfade with subtle zoom transition. Dot indicators at bottom.
  - Badge: "Solusi Logistik Terpercaya Indonesia" with animated ping dot
  - Headline: "Mastering Every Move with Precision" (orange accent on second line)
  - Two CTA buttons: "Konsultasi Sekarang" (orange) and "Hubungi Kami" (ghost/outline)
  - **ClientLogoSlider** (`/home/jajang/mastermove-landing/components/ClientLogoSlider.tsx`): Infinite horizontal auto-scrolling carousel of 19 client logos from `/clientslider-logos/`. Grayscale by default, color on hover. Fade-mask edges.

### (d) ServicesSection
- **File:** `/home/jajang/mastermove-landing/sections/ServicesSection.tsx`
- **Purpose:** Showcases 8 logistics services in a bento-grid layout. ID: `#services`. Contains:
  - Section badge "Layanan", heading "Solusi Logistik untuk Bisnis Modern"
  - Featured card (2-col, 2-row span): "Freight Forwarding Domestic" with "Unggulan" badge, radial gradient overlay, route-lines background pattern
  - 7 regular service cards in a 4-column grid: Customs Clearance, Pengiriman Darat, Pengiriman Laut, Pengiriman Udara, Pergudangan & Distribusi, Transportasi Multimoda, Asuransi Kargo
  - All cards are dark navy (`#0D2B52`) with white text, icon that turns orange on hover, subtle glass gradient overlay
  - Icons from lucide-react: Package, DollarSign, Truck, Ship, Plane, Warehouse, Network, Shield

### (e) AboutSection
- **File:** `/home/jajang/mastermove-landing/sections/AboutSection.tsx`
- **Purpose:** Company information section. ID: `#about`. Contains:
  - Two-column layout: text content (left) and team photo (right, from `/mastermove-team.png`) with orange glow border shadow
  - Three paragraphs describing the company (Indonesian logistics/freight forwarding company)
  - Vision card (dark navy): "Menjadi perusahaan logistik dan freight forwarding terpercaya..." with Eye icon
  - Mission card (dark navy): 4 bullet points with CheckCircle icons
  - Closing quote block: dark navy card with route-lines background, large quote icon in orange, company philosophy quote, orange accent line

### (f) WhyChooseUsSection
- **File:** `/home/jajang/mastermove-landing/sections/WhyChooseUsSection.tsx`
- **Purpose:** Trust/credibility section showcasing company legitimacy and portfolio. Contains:
  - Section badge "Mengapa Memilih Kami", heading "Keunggulan yang Membedakan Kami"
  - **Legalitas card (full-width):** Displays official company registration details (PT Mastermove Indonesia Era, NPWP, NIB, KBLI, SK number, Akta number, founded 2025) in a 3-column data grid
  - **Proyek Kami card:** Description of project portfolio with 4 project thumbnail images (`/project-image-1.jpeg` through `/project-image-4.jpeg`)
  - **Klien Kami card:** Client trust statement with composite client logos image (`/client-logos.png`)
  - **Bottom stats row:** 3 benefit badges with CheckCircle2 icons -- "Legalitas Terjamin", "Jaringan Luas", "Tracking Real-time", "Tim Profesional" (note: 4 benefits displayed in 3-column grid)

### (g) CTASection
- **File:** `/home/jajang/mastermove-landing/sections/CTASection.tsx`
- **Purpose:** Contact/CTA section. ID: `#contact`. Contains:
  - Dark navy banner with route-lines: "Siap untuk Solusi Logistik Terpadu?" heading, orange CTA button "HUBUNGI KAMI" linking to WhatsApp (`wa.me/6282189836838`)
  - **Branch locations grid (6 locations):** Jakarta, Surabaya, Depok, Makassar, Bandung, Balikpapan -- each in a white card with MapPin icon, address, and phone (some phones are placeholder XXXXXXX)
  - **Contact bar:** 3-column row with Email (info@mastermoveindonesia.com), WhatsApp (+62 821-8983-6838), LinkedIn profile link

### (h) Footer
- **File:** `/home/jajang/mastermove-landing/components/Footer.tsx`
- **Purpose:** Simple 3-column footer. Contains:
  - Logo (`/mastermove-logo-footer.svg`) + company tagline
  - Navigation links: Home, Layanan, Tentang Kami, Kontak
  - Contact info: email and WhatsApp
  - Copyright line: "PT Mastermove Indonesia Era. All rights reserved."

---

## 3. ADDITIONAL PAGES

### Projects Gallery
- **File:** `/home/jajang/mastermove-landing/app/projects/page.tsx`
- 13 projects with filterable category tabs (All, Warehouse, Heavy Machine, Office Moving)
- Masonry-style grid with hover overlays using Framer Motion
- Links to `/#contact` for consultation CTA

### Project Detail (Dynamic Route)
- **File:** `/home/jajang/mastermove-landing/app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx`
- 4 detailed projects with full case-study data (challenge, solution, outcomes, testimonial, timeline, scope)
- Uses dedicated sub-components from `/components/project-detail/`

---

## 4. STYLING APPROACH

**System:** Tailwind CSS v4 with `@tailwindcss/postcss`, plus custom component classes in `globals.css`.

**Color palette (from `tailwind.config.ts` and actual usage):**
| Token | Hex | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| `primary` | `#0A1F44` | Primary dark navy (headings, body text, dark sections background) |
| `accent` | `#EA580C` | Orange accent (CTAs, highlights, badges, icons on hover) |
| Card dark bg | `#0D2B52` | Slightly lighter navy for dark cards |
| Card hover bg | `#10345F` | Hover state on dark cards |
| Page background | `#F6F8FC` / `#F8FAFC` | Light gray-blue background |
| Body text | `#3A4A63` | Paragraph text color |
| Orange secondary | `#f26622` | Used in hero headline, footer hover |
| Orange CTA | `#ff5a00` | Hero button variant |

**Fonts (loaded via `next/font/google` in layout.tsx):**

|---|---|---|---|
| **Poppins** (400-800) | `--font-poppins` | `font-sans` | Body text, paragraphs, buttons |
| **Jost** (400-700) | `--font-jost` | `font-mono` / `font-jost` | Headings (h1-h6) |

**Custom component classes (in `globals.css` `@layer components`):**

| `.section-shell` | Section wrapper with responsive padding |
| `.section-container` | Centered max-w-7xl container |
| `.section-title` | Large bold heading style |

- Rounded corners everywhere: `rounded-[24px]` to `rounded-[32px]` for cards, `rounded-2xl` for buttons
- Consistent hover effect: `-translate-y-1` (1px lift) with enhanced shadow
- Dark cards consistently use `#0D2B52` bg with a diagonal glass gradient overlay (`linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.08), transparent 48%)`)
- All sections use orange pill badges with dot indicators as section labels

### Key architectural observations:
1. **All components use `"use client"` directive** -- the entire app is client-rendered.
2. **No data fetching layer** -- all data (services, projects, branches, mission points) is hardcoded inline within components. No API calls, no CMS, no database.
3. **Project data is duplicated** -- the projects list exists separately in both `/app/projects/page.tsx` (13 gallery items) and `/app/projects/[slug]/page.tsx` (4 detailed case studies) with different schemas and different slugs. They are not shared.
4. **Language is primarily Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia)** -- `lang="id"` on html element, Indonesian content throughout, with some English phrases mixed in (headings, taglines).
5. **Responsive design** uses Tailwind breakpoints (`sm:`, `md:`, `lg:`, `xl:`) throughout. Mobile menu is a simple toggle. Layouts shift from 1-column on mobile to multi-column on desktop.
6. **The `src/components/` directory** contains only `HeroSlider.tsx`, separate from the main `components/` directory. This is likely an artifact of iteration -- the rest of the components live in `components/`.
